detailed_description:
Hyperrealistic feline fur/materials in the same teal laundrette, copper practical lamp and cool window light. [Shot 1] Start from <Picture 1>. Mica notices a cue, lifts the head and ears, releases hunched shoulders and lowers/spreads the real feline forepaws into a loose open lower-chest dance pose. Over the opening few seconds Mica widens the hind-paw stance slightly, transferring weight naturally rather than sliding, and becomes visibly confident. At the same time Bramble's head dips slightly, ears turn modestly sideways, shoulders draw inward and forepaws tuck close together; the broad sway becomes a sheepish small sway. Show the full opposite personality change before settling into repeated grounded two-steps. Mica leads: one hind paw pushes, the body moves over the other planted paw, the free paw taps and returns, and weight transfers back. Forepaws bounce gently in alternation; tail counterbalances, chest breath and whiskers move subtly. Bramble follows with smaller amplitude. Reach the clear later posture contrast of <Picture 2>, then maintain that changed confidence through the final grounded shared groove. Keep genuine feline faces and closed mouths, exactly two cats, fixed paw count, no human hands. The camera keeps the opening wide full-body two-cat scale and a generous visible floor margin for this ENTIRE take. Both cats stay completely contained from ear tips through all hind paws and tail tips. Maintain the original camera distance and fixed near-normal focal length, with BOTH complete cats inside the middle of the portrait. The camera only trucks gently about15cm to the right while panning a little to keep the two-cat group centered; this small lateral move shows coherent laundrette parallax without approaching either cat. The complete planted hind paws, lifted tapping paws and contact shadows remain visible on the floor at every phase. End at the same wide full-body scale as the opening. The scene is a long full-body dance performance, so do not hand attention to a cropped portrait, enlarge Mica, push in, zoom or travel between the cats. Camera speed stays gentle independently of the deliberate slow dance. No internal cut, pose reset, morph, teleport or body swap.
